description:
FILED s444 from agent H (s443h), #516's residue; PRE-EXISTING SILENT WRONG + three deaths.  A MULTI-element paren base is broken for all four paren-scalar-base family members: _is_paren_scalar_base requires exactly ONE child where perl's rule is the comma operator's LAST element.  `my $r=[10,20]; print +(1,2,$r)->[1]` = 20 in perl, 2 in PCL (silent); `(1,2,$cr)->(4)`, `(1,2,$h)->{a}`, `(1,2,$o)->m1()` die.  PCL's scalar-context progn already answers last-element, so the fix is == 1 -> >= 1, but it moves three other emitters and wants its own corpus-diff + A/B.  Bar: the four family shapes vs perl + side-effect ordering `(f(),g(),$r)->[0]` (perl evaluates all).

=== DONE s448p (Opus agent P) ===

FIXED as the task predicted: Pl::ExprToCL::_is_paren_scalar_base `== 1` -> `>= 1`.
All four family members now agree with perl (`(1,2,$r)->[1]` = 20, `(1,2,$h)->{a}`,
`(1,2,$cr)->(4)`, `(1,2,$o)->m1()`), and the scalar-context progn the predicate
licenses already evaluates every element for its side effects â the ordering
probe `(f(),g(),$r)->[0]` gives perl's `10 f,g` in LIST context (it was already
right in SCALAR context, where the progn collapsed on its own; both spellings
are guard rows now).

THE TASK'S "it moves three other emitters and wants its own corpus-diff" WAS
RIGHT, and the corpus-diff caught a REGRESSION the probes could not:

  4 of 111 files differed â array.t, context.t, flip.t, list.t â all ONE shape,
  `qw(a b c)[2]`.  PExpr's qw-subscript branch (Pl/PExpr.pm ~1602) never set the
  `list_ctx_subscript` metadata that its paren twin (`(LIST)[i]`, ~1623) sets;
  the shape had been getting by on its base *happening* to be a multi-child
  node, and the moment a multi-child node became a scalar base all four started
  dereferencing the LAST WORD.

  `qw(a b c)[i]` IS `(LIST)[i]`, so the fix is the marker (rule 11: ONE marker
  for "this subscript is a list slice"), not a second test.  It restores all
  four byte-for-byte AND closes a pre-existing silent wrong: `qw(only)[0]`
  answered EMPTY on the base tree where perl says `only` (measured by reverting
  both files).

MEASUREMENTS
- corpus-diff vs the #570 commit: 4 files before the marker, IDENTICAL over 111
  after; silent drops 5, unchanged.
- emission-ab --ref over 1036 files (lib/**, perl 5.40.3 t/**, cpan-tests/**,
  Pl/t/shapes) â see the session report for the line.
- ~25 shapes probed vs perl 5.40.3, all identical after: the four members, both
  side-effect orderings, lvalue / chained / class-name / void, the
  single-element inverses, paren and qw list slices, a plain paren list.

GUARD: Pl/t/anon-sub-01.t 40 -> 53 rows (4.2 s), beside #516's family.  Five
fail on the base tree (inverse-run); the rest are the already-right inverses.
ir-spec Â§2.5 gains the normative rule.

RESIDUE FILED, both PRE-EXISTING and NOT reached by this fix:
  #611 â a NESTED paren base keeps LIST context (`((0,$h))->{k}` dies): the
         scalar context set on the base is not propagated through a transparent
         single-child paren layer into the inner group.
  #612 â the postfix-deref spellings `->@*` / `->$*` are not in the family at
         all (they never ask _is_paren_scalar_base): `(1,2,$r)->@*` yields
         `1,2,ARRAY(0x1)` where perl gives `10,20`.


=== A/B RESULT (the line the entry above deferred) ===

emission-ab --ref over 1036 files (lib/**, perl 5.40.3 t/**, cpan-tests/**,
Pl/t/shapes): 1035 SAME, 1 DIFF, RCDIFF 0 -- and the DIFF is ANOTHER INSTANCE OF
THE BUG, not a regression:

  t/op/gmagic.t:109  ${ (), $$s }[0] = 73;
  t/op/gmagic.t:114  ( ! $true ? undef : $$s )->[0] = 73;

the BRACED spelling `${ EXPR }[i]` of the same base.  Probed vs perl 5.40.3:
four rows (two of them LVALUES) were silently EMPTY on the base tree and are
correct after.  They are guard rows now (Pl/t/anon-sub-01.t row 54).

NEITHER companion file moves its verdict: op/gmagic.t stays C 30/3 DIFF
("Can't call method init on an undefined value" at form 5) and op/inccode.t
stays C 13/28 DIFF -- both abort before the fixed lines.  So NO companion
movement is expected from #570 or #527; the merge review's full sweep should be
+0 as well (corpus-diff IDENTICAL over all 111 perl-tests files).

Final guard count Pl/t/anon-sub-01.t 40 -> 54 rows (3.9 s).
